Cc: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@halcyon.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps on approval lag — Halcyon Systems (DL-2026-0785)

Hi team,

Quick note on Halcyon: forecast shows this deal as AT-RISK in the July commit bucket because the approved concession hasn't landed in HubSpot and finance can't count the revenue without the signed concession. Sam from Halcyon copied here asked for an updated close date.

Ben — can you confirm the outstanding sign-off items from Deal Desk? Laura — do we need any additional finance artifacts beyond the concession doc to lock the commit?

Goal: get clarity on whether we hold this in commit for July or move to best-case for August. If we need to move it, I want a one-line reason so FP&A can annotate the forecast.

Attachments: concession_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet, current ask/discount breakdown)

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

On Mon, Jul 6, 2026 at 9:12 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick note on Halcyon: forecast shows this deal as AT-RISK in the July commit bucket...

Evelyn — quick status: Deal Desk logged the request and routed to Sales Ops + Legal for the redlines on 7/5. Legal pushed a minor language tweak on the concession (payment milestone phrasing). We've got verbal agreement from the AE but Legal asked for confirmation that Halcyon will sign the concession without a further pricing concession.

I'm attaching the redline summary and the version Legal approved conditionally — they want a seeded, signed concession doc before Finance will reclassify. I expect an answer from Sam today; if we don't have a signed concession by EOD Friday (7/9) we should plan to move to August best-case.

Attachments: halcyon_signed_redlines.pdf

Ben Carter
Senior Deal Desk Analyst | Redwood Inference

From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@halcyon.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 15:22:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps on approval lag — Halcyon Systems (DL-2026-0785)

Ben / Evelyn,

Thanks for the update — sorry for the delay. We're finalizing procurement signatures on our side; the legal team asked for the same clarification Ben mentioned. I can confirm procurement will sign the concession as-is provided there are no additional hidden discounts or post-signature credits. Our target is to return the signed concession by Thursday (7/9) COB PT.

If Redwood needs an earlier decision point, we can escalate internally, but we'd prefer to keep the standard sign flow.

Sam Taylor
Procurement Manager | Halcyon Systems

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps on approval lag — Halcyon Systems (DL-2026-0785)

Update for the forecast log: Halcyon committed to signing by 7/09 COB PT. Action plan: 
- Ben: if signed concession arrives by 7/09 23:00 PT, please ensure it gets uploaded to HubSpot and notify Finance for commit reconciliation.
- Laura: if the concession is not uploaded by 7/10 09:00 PT, please move the deal to Best Case / August in the forecast and add a short annotation: "Pending external signature (procurement)."
- Evelyn: I'll notify FP&A with the final disposition and attach the concession doc.

Rationale: Finance requires a signed concession in CRM to treat the deal as committed revenue. We need a one-line reason in the forecast change log per process.

Please confirm you accept the timeline and responsibilities.

Evelyn Hart
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
